the BRST (anti)cohomology groups of the NSR superstring model are the same as those of the corresponding free bosonic string model, which is a surprising result.
the superstring BRST co-homology is not more complicated than the bosonic one, despite the fact that the BRST operator is a differential of ghost number 2 rather than 0.
